name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a cosmetic update?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a cosmetic update?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cosmetic update typically involves superficial changes that improve the appearance without altering the bathroom's layout or major systems. This could include painting, replacing fixtures, or updating a vanity. A full bathroom remodel, however, involves more extensive work, such as changing the layout, relocating plumbing, updating electrical systems, replacing flooring, and installing new showers or tubs. A full remodel generally takes longer and costs more.
acceptedAnswer.description: A cosmetic update refreshes appearance without changing layout or systems, while a full remodel involves extensive changes including plumbing, electrical, and layout.
